The '''Skirmish on Telerath''' took place several months after the creation of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]]. [[Dass Jennir]] defeated the criminals who ruled the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Telerath/Legends|Telerath]] single-handed.
